_comment: Curation judgements merged into INDEX.md by tpl_index.py. Keys under 'templates' are paths relative to templates/imported/ (or templates/ for own/). Statuses: complete | partial | unreviewed | draft.

filesystem/ntfs/NTFS FILE Record.tpl.notes: Per x-ways.net: knows nothing about fixup bytes, so values spanning the sector-end fixup positions read wrong on disk.

filesystem/ntfs/NTFS FILE Record (x-ways.notes: Same fixup caveat as the winhex-default copy; diff the two before trusting either.

filesystem/ntfs/NTFS Data Runs.tpl.notes: Decodes run headers via uint_flex; does not sum runs or follow sparse/compressed flags.

windows-artefacts/LNK FILE Record.tpl.notes: Per x-ways.net: structures at end of file remain partially undocumented; compare MS-SHLLINK before extending.

windows-artefacts/Non-Unicode LNK FILE R.notes: Same end-of-file caveat as the Unicode variant.

windows-artefacts/ETL_Header_x64.tpl.notes: Header only; trace buffers and events not covered.

windows-artefacts/EVTX Record Structure..notes: Record envelope verified: signature/size/id/FILETIME offsets correct and size==size-copy on every record walked. BinXML payload is beyond the template language. Note the 'requires 0 2A2A00' guard is 3 bytes where the signature is 4 (2A 2A 00 00). Cites a blog post rather than libyal.

file-formats/SQLite Header.tpl.notes: 100-byte database header only; b-tree pages and cells not covered. Expansion candidate: page header + cell pointer array.

file-formats/Dalet SND file header.txt.notes: Ships as .txt; rename to .tpl for X-Ways to list it.

file-formats/Dalet VOL file header.txt.notes: Ships as .txt; rename to .tpl for X-Ways to list it.

file-formats/Dalet BWF file header.txt.notes: Ships as .txt; rename to .tpl for X-Ways to list it.

windows-artefacts/EVTX File Header.tpl.notes: DEFECT (verified 2026-08-24, 6 logs): line 22 'move 3' should be 'move 2'. Reads Header block size at +41 (14864) and Number of chunks at +43 (0) instead of +40 (4096) and +42. Reports 0 chunks for a 65-chunk log. Other fields and the CRC-32 coverage note are correct. Corrected version: own/EVTX File Header.tpl.

windows-artefacts/EVTX Chunk Header.tpl.notes: All 9 declared field offsets verified correct against 6 logs; both CRC-32 coverage claims confirmed (events CRC over 512..free-space-offset, chunk CRC over 0..120 plus 128..512). Incomplete: omits unknown 56..120, common string offset array 128..384, and template pointer array 384..512. Fuller version: own/EVTX Chunk Header.tpl.

own/EVTX File Header.tpl.notes: Authored from libyal's spec plus our own byte-level verification (6 logs, 278 chunks, format 3.2). Covers all 4096 bytes with no gaps; CRC-32 over bytes 0..120 confirmed 6/6. Number of chunks @42 = chunks IN USE (matches ElfChnk signature count 6/6), NOT allocated capacity - 4 of 6 logs are allocated larger, and the trailing unwritten chunks are slack worth carving. Promote to complete after applying to logs from a different Windows build.

own/EVTX Chunk Header.tpl.notes: As above. Both CRC-32 claims verified empirically. The two 128..512 arrays are marked inferred - taken from libyal, not independently tested. Unknown +0x78 is 1 in every chunk sampled.
